lines: Telo Ride opens fast. The first load is ninety kilobytes, gzipped.
After every build, a check gzips exactly what the first screen downloads, and fails above three hundred.
The raw budget is tight: it warns at three oh two, and fails at three oh five.
The 3D world waits for the race. Home carries no Three.js at all.
Home's first load, from a phone to the full screen.
What the tests prove: a light first load, and the world only when you ride.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
